calls.reconciliation: The runs shared the same facts: guides 6.7/7.7/8.5/9.2B, actuals ~0.1B under guide, FY26 GAAP opex 23.076B, the 'low 50s' full-year comment, and the 14-week Q4. The spread between Run 3 (median 10.0) and Run 2 (median 10.25) comes from two things. The first is a factual unknown: whether the full-year comment is on a GAAP or non-GAAP basis. The dossiers can't settle this, so I carried both readings, which together span ~9.7-10.5B. The second is a judgment: how much weight to give the 14th week and the history of upward revisions. FY26 actual growth (~41%) appears to have landed at or above the 'high 30s' guidance (from memory, not in the dossiers), suggesting the comment tends to undershoot. Together with the 14th week and the larger past Q4 steps, I lean modestly above the GAAP-basis midpoint, to 10.15B. I carried the runs' ~0.95 dispersion forward because I agree with it, and set the outside-range masses at 2% below and 2.5% above. I did no retrieval this run.
